name: launchrail
description: A self-hosted platform for health-checked application deployments.

scripts.dev: pnpm build:packages && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names api,worker,web --prefix-colors blue,magenta,green 'pnpm --filter @launchrail/api dev' 'pnpm --filter @launchrail/worker dev' 'pnpm --filter @launchrail/web dev'
scripts.typecheck: pnpm build:packages && pnpm --filter './packages/*' --parallel typecheck && pnpm --filter './apps/*' --parallel typecheck
